title: Brian Chesky on 11-Star Experience Design
speaker: Brian Chesky
content: Brian Chesky explains how Airbnb designed their core user experience by imagining an 11-star experience. A 5-star experience is standard: you arrive, open the door, and the place is clean. A 6-star experience is when they leave a bottle of wine. A 7-star experience is when they pick you up in a limousine. An 11-star experience is Elon Musk taking you to space. By pushing design thinking to the absolute limit, you discover what truly wows customers and scale back to an unforgettably great product.

title: Casey Winters on Product-Market Fit and Retention Loops
speaker: Casey Winters
content: Casey Winters emphasizes that retention is the true cornerstone of product-market fit. Acquisition loops (like paid performance marketing or virality) only work if the underlying bucket isn't leaking. If your day-30 or month-3 retention curve does not flatten parallel to the x-axis, you do not have product-market fit yet. Focus on habits, feature retention cohorts, and natural frequency.

title: Elena Verna on Product-Led Growth and B2B Freemium
speaker: Elena Verna
content: Elena Verna breaks down Product-Led Growth (PLG) for B2B SaaS. PLG is not just self-serve signups; it is aligning your product usage with your monetization model. Product-led sales works by identifying active power users in self-serve workspaces and equipping enterprise sales reps to expand those accounts into corporate contracts.
